text: By adding parallel energy coils, Warp-Lightning Adepts can fire their all-annihilating warp lightning faster, though since the coils are not fully insulated from one another, heat transfer remains unavoidable

The staff wielded by a Warp-Lightning Adept is akin to a miniature warp lightning cannon. Increasing the purity of the warpstone within its core most directly enhances the energy density and firing accuracy of its warp lightning

The energy diverter channels the surplus energy from each warp lightning discharge into the staff's blade and energy armour, allowing the Warp-Lightning Adept to face down even the most powerful of beasts
